Our approach is founded on transparent communication, proactive client involvement and a strong commitment to quality throughout every stage of a project, from the initial consultation through to final handover.  Our custom-build projects include architecturally designed residences tailored to each client’s land, lifestyle and long-term vision. We also provide end-to-end design and construction services for townhouses, dual occupancies and residential apartment developments, managing projects from the approval stage through to completion and handover.  We undertake residential construction projects across Inner Melbourne, Bayside, Melbourne’s eastern and south-eastern suburbs, the Gippsland region, the Mornington Peninsula and the Yarra Ranges. Preparing detailed construction cost estimates based on project drawings, specifications and supporting contract documentation.  Undertaking accurate quantity take-offs using modern estimating technologies and recognised methods of measurement.  Preparing bills of quantities, schedules of rates, tender documentation and other project costing documents.  Maintaining and regularly updating project cost data to reflect current construction material, labour, subcontractor and market rates.  Preparing rate analyses and cost comparisons to assist management with tender evaluation and procurement decisions.  Assisting with the preparation and evaluation of tenders, subcontractor packages and supplier procurement documentation.  Monitoring project expenditure throughout all stages of construction to ensure that projects remain aligned with the approved baseline cost plan and budget. Undertaking rate analysis and participating in negotiations relating to variations, additional works and contractual claims.  Reviewing, evaluating and certifying subcontractor and contractor interim progress claims and final payment applications.  Conducting site inspections and taking site measurements in conjunction with relevant trades to verify work completed and quantities claimed.  Assessing the value of completed works and reconciling actual project expenditure against the approved construction budget.  Updating project programmes and construction schedules to reflect the actual progress of works across active projects.  Monitoring project milestones and assisting the project team to identify delays or issues that may affect project costs or completion dates.  Coordinating with directors, project managers, site supervisors, subcontractors, consultants, suppliers, clients and other project stakeholders.  Assisting with contract administration and maintaining accurate records relating to project costs, procurement, variations, claims and payments.  Supporting the delivery of projects within the approved budget, agreed timeframes, contractual requirements and applicable construction standards.
